sections.name: File setup, GET, packetCreateSchema, POST
sections.title: Packet list and create handlers
sections.what: Returns the packets for a case and creates a new packet from a verification result after checking the id format.
sections.why: Likely reason: the id format check blocks unexpected characters before the service runs.
sections.watch_out: The format check does not confirm the result exists, so the service must still do that.

summary: Web address to list review packets for a case and to create a new packet from a verification result.
purpose: Lets the app prepare a summary of a potential issue for review.
why: Likely reason: packets are built from stored results, so creation takes just one id.
how: GET returns the case's packets. POST checks that the result id uses only letters, digits, and hyphens, creates the packet through the service, and returns it. Tests show an unusable result returns 422 with PACKET_UNAVAILABLE. The rest of POST is cut off in the source.
inputs: Case id in the address. POST body with verificationResultId only.
outputs: A list of packets, or a created packet. Errors include INVALID_INPUT (400) and PACKET_UNAVAILABLE (422).
risks: The end of POST is cut off, so error handling after validation could not be fully checked.
debug: A 422 means the result belongs to another case or cannot be used. A 400 means the id has the wrong format.
